questions.question: On what date was the NPPA ceiling price notification S.O. 4886(E) issued from New Delhi under the Department of Pharmaceuticals?
Which earlier NPPA order dated 31 March 2023 is superseded by S.O. 4886(E) for the formulation packs listed in its table?
questions.answer: S.O. 4886(E) supersedes NPPA Order No SO 1573(E) dated 31st March, 2023, insofar as it relates to the formulation packs in the table, except for things done or omitted before the supersession.

questions.question: Under the NPPA ceiling price notification, what form must an existing manufacturer use to apply for prior price approval when launching a new drug in a scheduled formulation's strength?
questions.answer: The manufacturer must apply to the NPPA for prior price approval in Form I under Schedule-II of the DPCO, 2013.

questions.question: How far ahead must a manufacturer notify NPPA in Form-IV of Schedule-II before discontinuing a scheduled formulation under the 2024 ceiling price notification?
questions.answer: The manufacturer must furnish Form-IV information to the NPPA at least six months before the intended date of discontinuation.

questions.question: What is the NPPA ceiling price per tablet, excluding GST, for Co-trimoxazole 800mg + 160mg tablets?
questions.answer: The ceiling price is Rs. 2.30 per tablet (excluding GST).

questions.question: What is the NPPA ceiling price, exclusive of GST, for one 20mg Zinc Sulphate dispersible tablet?
questions.answer: The ceiling price is Rs. 3.41 per tablet.

questions.question: What is the NPPA ceiling price per tablet, excluding GST, for Tramadol 50mg tablets?
questions.answer: The ceiling price for Tramadol 50mg tablet is Rs. 9.70 per tablet.

questions.question: What is the NPPA ceiling price per tablet, excluding GST, for Temozolomide 250 mg tablets under S.O. 4886(E)?
questions.answer: The ceiling price for Temozolomide Tablet 250 mg is Rs. 3757.94 per tablet, exclusive of GST.
